name: Do guest houses increase property value?

mainEntity.name: Do guest houses increase property value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, building a guest house or ADU can significantly increase property value. It adds usable living space, which is a key factor for appraisals. A well-designed and constructed guest house can serve multiple purposes, such as providing rental income, accommodating multi-generational families, or offering a dedicated home office. This versatility makes a property more attractive to potential buyers, often resulting in a higher return on investment. The actual increase depends on local market conditions and the quality of the ADU.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, guest houses generally increase property value by adding versatile living space, improving marketability, and offering potential rental income.
